decision: Accept the material-scale and placement improvement provisionally; hold the Lotus decorative motif for one narrow helper correction after lead coordination. No runtime file was changed during review.

actual_render.scope: Actual native rendered screens and geometry. Fixture authority states stage plant/results for art review; not natural gameplay/input or hardware performance proof.

observations.finding: Metre-scale masonry is visible on counter/wall/partition faces. Indigo inserts break the previous uninterrupted tan block; stall emblem sits above actor height. Reticle lane, A cue and cover silhouette remain readable.

New panels follow existing boundary/divider/cover placement without apparent new route obstruction. Broad empty courts and repeated modular facades remain; this is not a finished dense urban production map.

Indigo glazed building and pale stone courses retain coherent hierarchy. Orange site outline and B label are distinct. Small carved cover panels are present; perimeter inserts read as a repeated decorative band.

The intended five leaves merge into a jagged star/maple silhouette, with downward side tips. Flat front planes and millimetre depth read like a stencil at this close camera; the intended lotus/stone-carving identity is not met.

Three diamonds are cleanly separated without visible clipping, but front planes also read flat. Fine grain is visible in the close native image; retain restrained material detail and prefer a physical beveled relief edge.

recommended_correction.action: Anchor Lotus petals to a common lower base with distinct upper lobes; add a shallow beveled inset front to relief polygons while keeping all vertices in the existing permitted regions.
preserve: Current core geometry and three material batches
recommended_correction.requires: Lead coordination before source mutation; focused authority/containment successor and matched close motif/approach native originals afterward.
